name: Click to Chat – Chat Contact Button & Floating Support
author: Aura Plugin

sections.description:
Click to Chat – Chat Contact Button & Floating Support

WhatsApp chat 💬 with a floating WhatsApp chat button 🟢, WhatsApp integration for WooCommerce 🔥, and fast, mobile-optimized customer support ⚡

The plugin keeps assets small through optimized icons, so your site stays quick. Add a WhatsApp link for support and sales, or go deeper with WooCommerce triggers and page-aware messages.

Why choose Click to Chat?

Store owners use it to add a direct WhatsApp line to their team and reduce friction before checkout. It is built around WooCommerce pages and everyday support workflows.

  • Improved conversion: a visible WhatsApp entry point can calm last-minute questions before purchase.
  • WooCommerce-aware: show or hide on shop, cart, checkout, account, and product flows as you prefer.
  • Performance-minded: compressed icons and lean front-end code.
  • Smarter links: optional context from the current page for clearer WhatsApp conversations.
  • Languages and RTL: Arabic, Turkish, German, Spanish, and 110+ other locales.
  • Orders and questions: customers can message about products from product pages in one step.
  • Quick setup: add your WhatsApp number, pick a style, and go live.

What you get

  • Business hours and offline messaging so expectations stay clear when you are away.
  • Six button styles to match your brand.
  • Built-in analytics for clicks and engagement.
  • Separate mobile and desktop offsets so the button stays out of the way of checkout and key controls.

Common uses

  • E-commerce help on product and catalog pages.
  • Order and shipping questions for international stores (including Turkish-speaking teams).
  • Lead capture on landing pages.
  • Ongoing client contact for offers and follow-ups.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the aura-chat-button folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate Aura Click to Chat from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open the plugin screen from the admin menu.
  4. Enter the phone number (with country code) and adjust the button and messages.
  5. Choose WooCommerce visibility and save.
sections.faq:
Is this compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes. It can follow WooCommerce screens and pass useful page context into the conversation.

Does image optimization help site speed?

Smaller icons load faster. That supports Core Web Vitals and a smoother mobile experience; it is not a guarantee of search rankings.

Can I use a business profile for messaging?

Yes. The link works with common personal and business setups on the major chat apps.

Do you support multiple languages?

Yes. The interface is translation-ready, including RTL languages and many locales.

Is the floating button mobile-friendly?

Yes. You can set offsets so it does not cover checkout, cart, or other important controls.

Can I use more than one phone number?

You configure one number in the settings; you can change it anytime or point it to the right agent for your store.

Does it open the app on phones and web on desktop?

It aims to open the native app on phones and a compatible web experience on larger screens when available.

Can I move the button?

Yes. You can set margins for mobile and desktop independently.

Can customers ask about a specific product?

Yes. Links from product pages can include context so customers reference the right item.
